sources.title: DiffHDR: Re-Exposing LDR Videos with Video Diffusion Models
sources.snippet: By operating in Log-Gamma color space, DiffHDR leverages spatio-temporal generative priors from a pretrained video diffusion model to synthesize plausible HDR radiance in over- and underexposed regions while recovering the continuous scene radiance of the quantized pixels.

sources.title: DiffHDR: Re-Exposing LDR Videos with Video Diffusion Models
sources.snippet: DiffHDR operates by conditioning a video diffusion model on LDR input frames. The architecture takes a sequence of LDR frames and learns to predict corresponding HDR frames through an iterative refinement process. The core mechanism involves diffusion, where the model starts with pure noise and gradually refines it across multiple steps.

sources.title: DiffHDR: Re-Exposing LDR Videos with Video Diffusion Models
sources.snippet: The authors created a method called DiffHDR to turn regular videos with limited brightness detail into videos with richer lighting, closer to what the human eye sees. They treat this as a problem of filling in lost light information by using a special kind of AI model trained on lots of videos.
